title: Size bound for the constructed circuit
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $f$ be a Boolean function on $n$ bits, and let $k$ be a natural number with $k\\le n$. The size of the circuit constructed from $f$ and $k$ is at most $2n+4\\cdot 2^{n-k}+2\\cdot 2^k+2^{2^k}$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a Boolean function on $n$ bits
